title: Excise Duty on Production Capacity Pvc Wires and Cables Rules 1994

sections.shortTitle: Excise Duty on Production Capacity Pvc Wires and Cables Rules 1994
sections.section: RULE - Excise Duty on Production Capacity (Pvc Wires and Cables) Rules 1994
sections.description:
EXCISE DUTY ON PRODUCTION CAPACITY (PVC WIRES AND CABLES) RULES, 1994
EXCISE DUTY ON PRODUCTION
CAPACITY (PVC WIRES AND CABLES) RULES, 1994.
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 1st
December, 1994]
Notification
No.S.R.0.1160(I)/94, dated 1st December, 1994.‑‑In exercise of the
powers conferred by subsection (4) of section 3 of the Central Excises Act,
1944 (I of 1944), read with section 37 thereof, the Central Board of Revenue,
with the prior approval of the Federal Government, is pleased to make the
following rules for the levy and collection of duty on the production capacity
of extruders used for the manufacture of PVC wires and cable, in lieu of the
duty of excise leviable on wires and cables under subsection (1) of the said
section, namely:‑‑
1. Short title, commencement
and application.‑‑(1) These rules may be called the Excise Duty on
Production Capacity (PVC Wires and Cables) Rules, 1994.
(2) They shall come into force at once and unless earlier
rescinded shall remain in force till the end of the financial year 1994‑95.
(3) They shall apply to such manufacturer who manufactures
only PVC wires and cables having cross‑sectional area not more than 8 mm
used for domestic purposes with the help of domestically fabricated extruders
and does not employ more than eight labourers including himself and his
dependents in the factory and elects for application of these rules as provided
in rule 3.
2. Interpretation.‑‑In these rules, unless
there is anything repugnant in the subject of context, the words and
expressions used but not defined herein shall have the same meaning as in the
Central Excises Act, 1944 (I of 1944) and the rules made under section 37
thereof.
3. Declaration to be made.‑‑The manufacturer
who elects to pay duty under these rules for the year 1994‑95 shall apply‑to
that effect in writing to the Superintendent of jurisdiction by the [15th)'
December, 1994 declaring the number of extruders installed in his factory and
shall pay excise duty at the rate of four thousand five hundred rupees per
extruder per month on all the extruders installed in the factory irrespective
of whether or not any extruder is working or in working condition.
4. Option to be irrevocable.‑‑The option
exercised under rule 3 shall be irrevocable for the financial year 1994‑95.
5. Amount of duty and date of payment.‑‑(1)
The amount of duty leviable for a year payable in accordance with these rules
shall be paid in equal monthly instalments, each payable by the manufacturer by
the 10th of each month in advance and duty for July, 1994 to November, 1994
must be paid before the 15th December, 1994.
(2) If any instalment is not paid by the due date, the
manufacturer shall, without prejudice to any other penal action which may be
taken under the Central Excises Act, 1944 or the rules framed thereunder be
liable to pay an additional duty in terms of section 3B of the aforesaid Act.
6. Removal and addition.‑‑(1) A manufacturer
may replace an extruder installed in the factory after giving at least ten
days' advance notice to concerned Superintendent and the extruder installed in
factory shall be dismantled before any action is taken to install a new
extruder.
(2) If during the‑course of the financial year, the
manufacturer instals an additional extruder in his factory, he shall pay duty
thereon from the beginning of the month in which the additional extruder is
installed.
7. Abatement not allowed.‑‑(1) No abatement of
duty shall be admissible if any extruder is removed from the factory.
(2) No rebate or remission of excise duty shall be allowed
under rule 12 or rule 13 of the Central Excise Rules, 1944, on the export of
P.V.C. vires and cables manufactured in factories electing to pay duty under
these rules.
8. Maintenance of record not required.‑‑The
manufacturer electing to pay duty under these rules shall not be required to
maintain any central excise record pertaining to production or clearance of
goods.
